title: How Khaprail Roof Tiles Are Installed: Slope, Battens and Overlap
excerpt: How khaprail roof tiles are installed: roof slope, batten spacing, overlap, fixing and finishing, plus what to ask your contractor before you order.
meta_title: How to Install Khaprail Tiles: Slope, Battens, Overlap
meta_description: How to install khaprail tiles? See how slope, battens, overlap and ridge finishing work, what to ask your contractor, and get a free Pak Clay sample.
answer_box: Khaprail tiles are laid in overlapping rows on battens over a sloped roof, so water runs from tile to tile and off the roof. Check the minimum slope for your profile, set the battens from a real sample, agree the overlap and fixing, and finish ridges, edges and valleys carefully.
ai_summary: Khaprail roof installation depends on a suitable slope, evenly spaced battens, the right overlap and careful finishing at ridges, edges and valleys. Pak Clay, making clay products in Lahore since 1982, does not publish one slope figure for all profiles and advises confirming it with your engineer and supplier.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: How much does khaprail tile installation cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on roof area, frame, underlay, profile, labour rate, access and finishing. Tile price and labour are separate lines, so ask for a written quote that lists both with a date.

faqs.question: Is a khaprail roof better than a concrete tile roof?
faqs.answer: Neither wins in every case. Clay and concrete tiles differ in weight, finish and colour behaviour, and both need correct laying. Our clay vs concrete guide compares them for Pakistani conditions.

faqs.question: What slope does a khaprail roof need?
faqs.answer: The minimum slope depends on the profile and overlap. Ask your supplier for the figure for your exact tile, and ask your engineer to confirm that your roof frame meets it.

faqs.question: Can khaprail tiles go on a flat concrete roof?
faqs.answer: Usually a sloped frame or a built-up slope is needed first, because tiles shed water by gravity and overlap. Ask an engineer to check the structure and load before you order.

faqs.question: What should I do before the tiles arrive?
faqs.answer: Confirm the frame and slope with your engineer, get a sample for the contractor to set out battens, order spares and plan safe access. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp for a free sample.
